module: Flowgraph node "Mini Graph" (category repeat_instant, tags util/draw/table/data). Small graph (200x60) in the node that plots a single number value over frames (last 100 points). Parameters in data: scaleMin/scaleMax (0..1 by default), autoScale (true: the scale grows with the values) and stop (true: stops recording). Input: value (number).

work.desc: Adds the value (0 if nil) to the series, updates the scale and removes the oldest point beyond the max size, unless data.stop.
